synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — a durable cash-generative franchise at floor multiples, but the top line has actually stalled and the peer discount is partly earned.

bull_points.claim: On the forward basis the discount narrows further — NTM TEV/EBITDA 6.59x vs peer median 9.66x and NTM P/E 9.2x vs peer median 12.76x — so the cheapness is not merely a trailing artifact.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bull_points.claim: The peer discount is only partially EARNED and partly RESIDUAL for the human to judge: Gartner's LT EPS growth of 14% actually EXCEEDS the peer-median 12% and beta matches at 0.9, even as margin (21% vs 31%) and near-term growth (2% vs 8%) run below — POSE whether a -31% EV/EBITDA gap is fully explained by those deltas or overshoots them.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: The peer set is HETEROGENEOUS ($751M–$119.1B caps, 159x span, mixed data/credit/IT-services models), so 'cheap vs peer median' is a confidence-gated input rather than a clean benchmark and the median may not price Gartner's model.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Financial Data (market-cap dispersion) + Business Description

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA is RISING through the de-rate — Dec-2021 1,148 → Mar-2026 (LTM) 1,337 — and absolute revenue is at a series high (6,474 LTM), so the falling margin % is not falling absolute profit.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The business generates $1,064M levered free cash flow and ROIC of ~19.4% LTM (18%+ every year since 2022), consistent with a durable subscription franchise, not a wasting asset.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: Management deployed that cash to shrink the share count -13.1% over ~1.8 years (77.1M → 67.0M), and the CFO cited ~4% reduction in Q1 alone from $535M of buybacks — accretive into the de-rate.
The drawdown traces to a single discrete gap-down on the 2026-02-03 earnings/Reg-FD 8-K rather than a cascade of solvency events, consistent with a sentiment/guidance reset.
bull_points.source_ref: EDGAR 8-K item codes at the gap-down dates (not blanket-labelled earnings)

bull_points.claim: Management posture points to reacceleration: the CFO said Q1 contract-value growth accelerated from Q4 and raised full-year EBITDA/adjusted-EPS/FCF guidance, with the March slowdown attributed to a transient geopolitical pause.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Gartner, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 05, 2026.rtf; Gartner, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 03, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: The core growth engine has stalled: LTM revenue actually DIPPED (6,497 → 6,474) with same-quarter revenue YoY at -1.5%, and consensus revenue revisions run 0↑/3↓ last month — the de-rate may price a real growth-terminal, not an overshoot.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: The margin trend is a genuine multi-year decline — EBITDA margin 24%→21% from 2021 to LTM — and this is the REAL signal on the margin leg even though absolute EBITDA rose, because the peer gap (21% vs 31%) makes the discount partly EARNED.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: On fundamentals the discount is at least partly EARNED, not pure overshoot: rev growth 2% vs peer 8%, EBITDA growth 2% vs peer 7%, and Debt/EBITDA 2.4 vs peer 1.8 all run worse than the peer median — a value-trap reading is available.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: Revenue is heavily concentrated in one segment — Insights at 78% of total (5,073 of 6,497) — so any subscription/retention erosion in that single engine is not diversified away.

Management itself flagged structural headwinds — DOGE-related U.S. federal pressure, extended buying cycles, deferred decision-making — and Q1 GTS new business was down 4% and GBS down 2% YoY, so the growth stall is not purely geopolitical noise.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Gartner, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 05, 2026.rtf; Gartner, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 03, 2026.rtf

decisive_question.question: Is the sub-1%ile de-rate pricing a transient demand pause (geopolitical/federal) in a durable subscription franchise that reaccelerates, or a structural growth-and-margin decline that makes the peer discount EARNED?

evidence_for.claim: Contract-value growth accelerated in Q1 vs Q4 and management raised full-year EBITDA/EPS/FCF guidance, attributing the March softness to a transient geopolitical pause.
